notes.title: 4-15 Content Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[i]Absinthia [/i]has its first free content update! This update is mainly for testing out Steam's Update Visibility Round feature to see if it results in a healthy bump in pageviews and sales. If so, I'll be planning out more larger content updates to expand on Absinthia's story!

[b]Master Mode[/b]
A fifth difficulty, Master Mode, is now available from the difficulty selection in the introduction. [b]This is by far [i]Absinthia[/i]'s hardest difficulty mode, and it can only be selected from the introduction.[/b] If you switch off of it later by using the manual, you won't be able to switch back unless you start a new game.

[b]Feline Island[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/7f237f4224af3f181253c27f300960f73ae68632.png[/img]
A new location can be unlocked after speaking with Mr. Kitty on the ship (after obtaining the ship, of course). This island features a new endgame boss, Cleocatra, that gets stronger each time you defeat her. Cleocatra, as well as her kitty minions, have a high chance to drop stat-boosting items.

[b]Rematch with Ibuki[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/c3269c53f8de48cad59d0ed64f877cc989bba956.gif[/img]
Ibuki can now be rematched anytime after her first defeat. she has some new tricks up her sleeve and, similar to Cleocatra, will get even stronger every time she's defeated. She'll have rewards after her 3rd and 5th rematch defeats, and has a high chance to drop more stat-boosting items after defeat as well.

[b]Full changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new island has appeared off the coast of Pense in preparation for the next content update. Feel free to visit, though there's not much there (yet)
[*]Added a new stat-boosting item, Catspaw, that boosts Agility by 1 and is rewarded by defeating Cleocatra on her 1st defeat (and has a chance to drop from her each time, too)
[*]Added a new stat-boosting item, Oni's Blessing, that boosts Strength and Intellect by 2 and is rewarded by rematching and defeating Ibuki 3 times (and has a chance to drop from her each time, too)
[*]Added a new accessory, the Berserker Band, that drops from Ibuki after rematching and defeating her 5 times
[*]Added a new accessory, the Ring of Zoomies, for defeating Cleocatra 5 times
[*]Added a new item, Catnip, that is bought from Feline Island for 500 gold and used to summon Cleocatra
[*]Added two new items, Swift Tonics and Swift Potions, that restore HP and MP and (usually) go first in turn order. Swift Tonics can be bought from Pangaea at the Sorrowmurk, and both can be bought from the vendor at Feline Island, in addition to dropping from certain enemies
[*]Mr. Boat Kitty and the cats of Feline Island now speak in meows
[*]Fixed Elle sometimes appearing twice in Katti Town after a certain story event
[*]The ship now has a minimap icon
[*]Fixed many tileset passability issues
[*]Sera's Snowstorm and Nirvana skill damage buffed slightly, and Nirvana lowers slightly more Agility
[*]Freya's Rotting Rose weapon buffed to grant bonus MP 
[*]Updated Jake's Neutralizer tooltip to reflect that it does not scale off of his Item Effectiveness stat (Grab Bag still does, though)
[*]Apollyons were buffed slightly
[*]Story Mode was adjusted so enemies have a bit more HP than before, but all other enemy stats are significantly lower
[*]Hard Mode now grants enemies small bonuses to Armor, Intellect and Wisdom
[*]Master Mode, in addition to giving higher stats than Hard Mode, grants many enemies the ability to absorb elements they were previously resistant to, as well as making Tank and Mage-class enemies even more resistant to physical and magic attacks respectively. Also, some slimes regenerate HP
[*]Saving is disabled while in the Old Cabin in Katti Town
[*]Added new achievements for:
[*] -Beating the game on Master Mode
[*] -Defeating Cleocatra 5 times
[*] -Rematching and defeating Ibuki 5 times
[/list]

If you have any suggestions or issues with the update, feel free to comment here, email me (jkweath @ gmail) or [url=https://discord.gg/cE2fCQAjC6]join our Discord server[/url] as I don't monitor Steam discussions.

If you enjoy the game, [b]don't forget to leave a review![/b]

notes.title: October Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Hope you're doing well!

[i]Absinthia's [/i]development is going smoothly! Most of September was spent fulfilling Kickstarter backers with in-game rewards and finishing up content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/7957698d987b8187908af4ea86325d6dbf850011.jpg[/img]
Katti Town's mayor Griswold has retired and been replaced with mayor Grace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/c3269c53f8de48cad59d0ed64f877cc989bba956.gif[/img]
Ibuki's treasure is yours to have, but only if you can defeat her in combat. Good luck!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/19bc808b5517d1e7684df328cf15d56188ac3163.png[/img]
An enemy requested by a Kickstarter backer. He was a blast to design. You'll hate fighting him, though.😁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/d7dfbb25d769e13187f7347eb52a8057e55b57d4.png[/img]
Crafty Coyote will sell equipment and give valuable hints on where to find hidden areas (alternatively, coyote trivia).

---

Going into October, [i]Absinthia [/i]is officially content-complete! There's still plenty of work to be done, though - lots and lots of testing to be done and assets to be finished. Assuming no delays, [i]Absinthia [/i]will be almost completely finished by early December. Once all the testing and assets are done, I'll begin sending out surveys to the remaining KS backers and distributing pre-release keys.

[b]Expanded Demo[/b]

In the next few weeks or so, I'll be updating Absinthia's demo with lots of various small changes and, most importantly, new content! The city of Eastport, home to the Eastport Pirates--as well as many Kickstarter backer NPCs--will be available alongside a new dungeon and two new mini-dungeons. 

That's all for this month. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848070/Absinthia/]Don't forget to add Absinthia to your wishlist![/url] Wishlists help indie games such as mine gain visibility and traction on Steam - they're essential for a strong release day!

If you'd like to see more frequent Absinthia content, feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]follow me on Twitter[/url] or [url=discord.gg/seY7xURTuh]join or Discord server![/url]

notes.title: Absinthia Post-Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This announcement's long overdue - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/jkweath/absinthia]the Absinthia Kickstarter was a success[/url]! It was a narrow victory as we just managed to pass 100% in the last day of funding.

Unfortunately the victory wasn't without its drawbacks:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/d72dbddb86c215055d7030466635629cdd3bca90.png[/img]

While it's common for campaigns to lose 2-5% from bad payment information, two of our biggest contributions got dropped, meaning we lost more than 10% of our funding goal after the campaign ended. The good news is that [i]Absinthia[/i] is still being developed on schedule; the bad news is that I had to make a few budget cuts.

[h3]Kickstarter backer surveys[/h3]

In the next couple months or so (probably September), I'll start sending Kickstarter backer surveys. Backers who pledged for in-game rewards will get their surveys first, and we'll begin working on their rewards ASAP after surveys are sent out.


Anyway, here's a few screenshots with some new stuff and two new music tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/2703cbd2e60b4f0849cdd9e9500bec7b39d4ea4a.png[/img]
A ship! It's practically a custom for most of my games to have a ship. This time around, you'll have the option to move around the ship and chat while you're sailing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/2706ca023800cca8132eb039ba67774f3e03aa6d.png[/img]
New enemies! Enemy sprite art is being done by artist [url=https://twitter.com/jamiebrownhill_]Jamie Brownhill[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41960886/04d146230e77b27e3bab9bd2900f6a91ec6d2097.gif[/img]
I've shown off the Eastport Catacombs before, but there's some new enemy overworld sprites here as well as an animated sewer pipe.

And here's two new music tracks by [i]Absinthia's [/i]composer Jazz Stewart:

[previewyoutube=uZyXOoxJdOo;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=Ut5T84grCcg;full][/previewyoutube]

And that's all for for now! If you'd like more frequent updates, you can:

[url=https://twitter.com/Jkweath]Follow me on Twitter[/url]

[url=discord.gg/seY7xURTuh]Join our Discord Server[/url]

Have a great week!
